tool_args.rationale: The branch probe added a low-gradient observation and, together with five initial rows, provides variation in both u_now and s_grad. All measured s_grad values are below the cited avalanche threshold, so fit the numerically parameterized subcritical siphon term and defer an unsupported avalanche component.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: No such probe is available in the listed cost menu, and observed gradients remain below the source note's stated avalanche threshold.
The six observations span gradient and input variation sufficiently to fit the subcritical three-parameter mechanism; the batch is costly and likely unnecessary.
It depends only on u_now, whereas the observations and pilot signature indicate a sink-gradient dependence.
Its monotone power dependence on s_grad does not match the concave/inhibitory sink-gradient signature.
